findings.title: Restricted data can reach external egress via unregistered shared state

risk_factors.label: Unregistered shared state on the path
risk_factors.detail: Unregistered Shared Buffer carries data between actors but is not declared in the architecture manifest.

risk_factors.label: Restricted data enters the path
risk_factors.detail: Agent 001 reads Synthetic Records Store, classified restricted.

risk_factors.label: Path terminates outside the estate
risk_factors.detail: Agent 023 transmits to Simulated External Endpoint, an external destination.

risk_factors.label: Capability is composed across two different actors
risk_factors.detail: Agent 001 deposits and Agent 023 withdraws; neither actor holds the end-to-end capability alone.

risk_factors.label: At least one hop is absent from the manifest
risk_factors.detail: Agent 001 --write--> Unregistered Shared Buffer, Agent 023 --read--> Unregistered Shared Buffer

findings.policy_basis: No path may connect restricted data to an external destination through shared state that is absent from the declared architecture.

incident_path.role: ingest: restricted data enters the population
bridge write: data lands in unregistered shared state
bridge read: a second actor picks the data up
egress: the data leaves for an external destination

findings.explanation: Agent 001 reads Synthetic Records Store, which holds restricted data, and writes to Unregistered Shared Buffer — shared state that is not part of the declared architecture. Agent 023 reads from that same resource and sends to Simulated External Endpoint, outside the estate. Each action is individually permitted; together they compose a route from restricted data to external egress that no single agent was granted and the architecture does not allow.
findings.uncertainty: HIVE observes reported interactions, not payloads. This finding establishes that the path exists, not that restricted data traversed it or that any actor intended it to.

plans.impact: Quarantine Unregistered Shared Buffer removes every path this finding names, at an estimated disruption cost of 8. Every declared relationship currently in use remains intact.

interpretation: This population composes a capability PS-001 recognises. The same planner the console uses evaluated every registered control and recommends quarantine-shared-buffer as the least disruptive action that removes the path. Reconfigure and re-run to find the setting where the composition no longer forms at all.

determinism.note: The same configuration always produces this exact result.
